correctness.rationale: The independent-mod-P2 stratum is classified by the kernel of the universal free 2-step Lie map, which lies in the exterior-square layer. Homogeneity promotes equality of marked quotients to equality of automorphism orbits, and every kernel subspace is realized in the age. For arbitrary tuples, a kernel plus preimage-of-P2 pair supplies an overcount of marked generated substructures. Gaussian-binomial estimates then sandwich both injective and all-tuple logarithmic orbit counts at n^4/16+O(n^3). The verifier independently enumerates finite subspaces and quotient signatures in small cases.
